BrochureContent.Content:
Ideally positioned on the highly regarded Howth Road, this attractive detached dormer bungalow enjoys a superb location just a short stroll from Sutton Cross, Sutton Lawn Tennis Club and Sutton DART Station, offering exceptional convenience for commuters and families alike.

The property is perfectly placed to enjoy all that the Howth and Sutton peninsula has to offer. A wealth of local amenities are within easy reach, including shopping facilities at Sutton Cross, the Marine Hotel, Sutton Golf Club and an excellent selection of both primary and secondary schools. Just one DART stop away, Howth Harbour offers a vibrant coastal atmosphere with an outstanding choice of restaurants, cafés and traditional pubs, together with the yacht club, scenic walks and a host of recreational amenities.

The accommodation is complemented by a generous, private, sunny rear garden featuring a versatile garden room, ideal as a home office, studio, gym or hobby room.

Internally, the accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall, two interconnecting reception rooms, a cosy family room (which may also serve as Bedroom 2), kitchen, Bedroom 1 and a family bathroom. Upstairs there is a further bedroom, a bathroom and a useful attic storage room.

Additional features include gas-fired central heating and double-glazed windows throughout.

Viewing is highly recommended and can be arranged by appointment through Gallagher Quigley Estate Agents by email at Info@gallagherquigley.ie or by telephone on +353 1 818 3000.
